description: Agent Guard Pre/PostToolUse secret scanning via the stable launcher

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'if [ -z "${HOME:-}" ]; then u=$(id -un) && case x$u in x|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) exit 2;; esac && HOME=$(eval cd ~$u 2>/dev/null && pwd) || exit 2; export HOME; fi; exec "$HOME/.config/agent-guard/run.sh" --tool claude'
